description: Faz 8-P2 P2-0B characterization corpus — V1 (compute_raw_from_delta + provenanced_from_raw) vs V2-candidate (measure_task_delta) semantic divergence measurement. Case content is produced by Rust builders (crates/osp-core/tests/common/faz8_p2_cases.rs); this manifest pins each case's serialized-bytes BLAKE3 digest so builder drift is DETECTED (explicit fixture+digest update required). Corpus change is detected by digest verification, not prevented.

divergence_classes.matching_scope: task.predicate.scope and proposal.affected_nodes describe the same node set — parity expected
divergence_classes.wide_affected_scope: proposal.affected_nodes is a strict superset of task.predicate.scope — known production-reachable divergence (V1 measures wider centroid)
divergence_classes.removed_edge_external_source: removed_edges[*].from references a node outside task.predicate.scope — divergence (V1 folds into affected set)
divergence_classes.delta_introduced_subject: task.predicate.scope members are all introduced by the delta — V2 baseline Unavailable, V1 always has current_measured
divergence_classes.mixed_per_axis_sources: subject members report different MetricSource per axis — V2 per-axis provenance (Mixed possible) vs V1 uniform Scip

cases.description: Task targets Node(1) via Node(1) predicate scope; proposal declares affected_nodes=[1]. Node 1 pre-exists in space. Subject set identical V1/V2 — parity expected for all metrics.
cases.notes: Baseline parity case. If this diverges, the harness itself is broken.

cases.description: KNOWN production-reachable divergence. Task Node(1) predicate scope; proposal affected_nodes=[1,2,3]. V1 subject={1,2,3} (affected centroid), V2 subject={1} (task scope centroid). Divergence expected across subject/values/loss/decision.
cases.notes: Core ontological divergence case — subject authority: LLM-affected vs task-derived. P2-1 cannot open without resolving this.

cases.description: Task Node(1) scope; affected_nodes=[1] but removed_edges[0].from=9 (external node). V1 folds 9 into affected set (navigator pattern), V2 subject scope {1} excludes it. Divergence in V1 centroid only.
cases.notes: removed_edges.from external to task scope — V1 affected-set contamination.

cases.description: Subject node 1 delta-introduced (not in base space). V2 baseline Unavailable (AllMembersIntroducedByDelta) → project_v1_loss_before_compatibility fail-closed (loss_before=loss_after → improved=false → Reject). V1 always has current_measured → improvement evaluable.
cases.notes: V2 'progress unprovable without baseline' semantics vs V1 'always has current_measured'. Decision divergence expected.
